title: Manufacturing process types
caption: Moving down, volume rises and variety falls: from a one-off ship to oil refining that never stops. The process a firm uses follows from how many it makes and how much each differs.
alt: Five stacked layers from low volume and high variety to very high volume: project, jobbing, batch, mass, continuous.
description: Project: unique, large products, such as a bridge or ship.
Jobbing: low volume, high variety, such as a bespoke tailor.
Batch: groups of identical items, such as a bakery's loaves.
Mass: high volume, standardised, such as cars on an assembly line.
Continuous: very high volume, non-stop flow, such as oil refining.
